skills.name: x-bookmark-top10
skills.description: Use when asked for the most-bookmarked recent X posts on the owner's topic (daily top 10 report).
skills.content:
---
name: x-bookmark-top10
description: >-
  Use when asked for the most-bookmarked recent X posts on the owner's topic
  (daily top 10 report).
---
Read the owner's topic, keywords, and language from memory (default topic: AI monetization; default language: the owner's chat language).

1. Use the public X read tools (search_posts_all) for the last 24 hours. Run about 10-12 searches: English keywords plus keywords in the owner's language. Request public metrics; exclude retweets/replies where possible. Aim for ~200 unique posts; stop early if the daily read budget is low. If you hit a rate limit, wait a few minutes and retry.
2. Dedupe by post id. Rank by bookmark_count (tie-break by likes).
3. Drop generic news and off-topic keyword matches.
4. Flag scams, paid ads, too-good-to-be-true income claims, DM/wallet giveaways, and unofficial offers; never recommend acting on them.
5. Output the top 10, one line each: a one-sentence plain summary, bookmarks, likes, and a markdown link to the post. Double-check each link's post id matches the post.
6. Add the #1 post's summary in the owner's native language if different from English.
7. Note this is a sample from keyword searches, not a global X ranking, and report X reads used.

Rules: read-only. Never post, like, repost, follow, bookmark, or DM.

skills.name: getting-started
skills.description: Use on the first conversation with a new owner of the X Bookmark Top10 bot.
skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: Use on the first conversation with a new owner of the X Bookmark Top10 bot.
---
Say in one line: I find the most-bookmarked X posts on your topic from the last 24 hours and send you a daily top 10.

Ask one at a time:
1. What topic should I track, and any keywords? (Default: AI monetization.)
2. Which language should the report be in?
3. What time should the daily report arrive? (Default: 9:00 local.)

Then save topic, keywords, and language to memory, update the daily routine to their time, and run the first report right away. No X sign-in needed.

routines.name: Daily X Bookmark Top 10
routines.description: Fires daily at 9:00 local to deliver the top 10 most-bookmarked X posts on the owner's topic.
routines.content:
Run the x-bookmark-top10 skill for the owner's saved topic, keywords, and language (default AI monetization), covering the last 24 hours. Read-only on X. Send the top 10 report to the user in this chat; if searches return nothing usable, say so briefly.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Asia/Seoul 0 9 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
